sources_considered.why: The researchers' institution describes practical simulation limitations and a working hybrid approach.
The original RoboCasa paper supplies experimental evidence of benefits from simulation and remaining limitations.

evidence_items.locator: Taking your robot home, limitations paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: This institutional report documents concrete limitations relevant to household manipulation. It concerns simulation-assisted training and does not establish that simulation-only reasoning is impossible or caused the absence of general-purpose robots.

evidence_items.locator: Section V-C, Transfer to Real World Environments
evidence_items.explanation: RoboCasa found benefits from combining simulated and real demonstrations on limited kitchen tasks. This qualifies a broad dismissal of simulation, but does not test simulation as a complete physical-reasoning method.

unresolved_gaps: Neither study isolates simulation-only physical reasoning as a cause of the missing general-purpose capability.
Practical difficulties with current simulators do not establish the categorical claim that the necessary reasoning cannot be accomplished through simulation.
The studies do not provide a comprehensive deployment survey of household robots.
